surfaces.current_boundary: ErrorBoundary class component (src/components/error-boundary.tsx) mounted in main.tsx (outer) and App.tsx (inner, inside AppShell)
surfaces.user_visible_behavior: 'Something went wrong' centered card with raw error.message and a Reload button
surfaces.diagnostic_behavior: Sentry.captureException(error) wrapped in try/catch (swallows init failure); console.error logs error + info.componentStack; componentStack NEVER sent to Sentry
surfaces.recovery_mechanism: setState({hasError:false}) then window.location.reload() unconditionally — the state reset is redundant, page always hard-reloads
surfaces.sensitive_data_exposure_risk: HIGH — raw error.message rendered to user (including ApiContractError detail which can include endpoint identifiers and bounded decoder diagnostics)
surfaces.duplicate_report_risk: MODERATE — same render error may also fire window.error if React does not swallow it
surfaces.disposition: F1.6.2: replace with RootErrorBoundary (full-screen) + RouteErrorBoundary (AppShell-preserved). Synchronous reportRuntimeError. Allowlisted message only — no raw error.message.

surfaces.current_boundary: None. 19 lazy() calls in AppRoutes.tsx wrapped in single Suspense fallback (spinner-only). Failed dynamic import bubbles to inner ErrorBoundary → window.location.reload() → near-certain repeat failure → reload loop.
surfaces.user_visible_behavior: Transient spinner, then 'Something went wrong', then hard reload, then likely repeat
surfaces.diagnostic_behavior: Reaches ErrorBoundary.componentDidCatch → Sentry.captureException once (no module path or route context attached)
surfaces.recovery_mechanism: Reload button (window.location.reload) — likely to fail identically if deployment manifest is broken
surfaces.sensitive_data_exposure_risk: LOW — chunk-load errors do not carry research content
surfaces.disposition: F1.6.3: wrap each lazy() in lazyRoute() that throws LazyRouteError; classify category=lazy_route_error; one guarded user-triggered reload via sessionStorage marker (keyed by build+route); marker cleared only by LoadedRouteWrapper useEffect after successful mount.

surfaces.current_boundary: NONE — React error boundaries do not catch errors in event handlers (onClick, onChange, etc.). These currently bubble to window.error if uncaught, otherwise are swallowed by the browser.
surfaces.user_visible_behavior: Silent — UI appears unresponsive to the click
surfaces.sensitive_data_exposure_risk: MEDIUM — event-handler closures may capture research text in their stacks
surfaces.disposition: F1.6.2: window.error observer installed via runtime-observers.ts; calls reportRuntimeError(category=global_error). Sanitizer strips stacks (allows component_stack only, sanitized).

surfaces.current_boundary: NONE — no unhandledrejection listener. Promise chains outside React (SSE, dynamic imports, async callbacks) currently log to console only.
surfaces.user_visible_behavior: Silent — console error invisible to user
surfaces.sensitive_data_exposure_risk: HIGH — rejection reasons may carry ApiError detail, response bodies, or research text
surfaces.duplicate_report_risk: MODERATE — if the rejection originated from a query, TanStack may also surface it locally
surfaces.disposition: F1.6.2: unhandledrejection observer installed via runtime-observers.ts; calls reportRuntimeError(category=unhandled_rejection). Sanitizer NEVER transmits raw rejection reason — only normalized error_name + allowlisted category message. AbortError filtered.

surfaces.current_boundary: NONE — no window.addEventListener('error', ...) in application code. Only SSE/keydown/mousedown listeners exist.
surfaces.duplicate_report_risk: MODERATE — render errors may fire BOTH componentDidCatch AND window.error
surfaces.disposition: F1.6.2: window.error observer; deduplicates against boundary-caught errors via WeakMap<Error> identity AND category-independent fingerprint fallback.

surfaces.surface: Third-party component crashes (TreeVisualization, MarkdownRenderer, governance panels)
surfaces.current_boundary: Inner ErrorBoundary in App.tsx catches render errors from descendant third-party components
surfaces.user_visible_behavior: 'Something went wrong' — full content area replaced (AppShell survives only because boundary sits inside it, but fallback is full-viewport anyway)
surfaces.sensitive_data_exposure_risk: MEDIUM — third-party stacks may include props/context
surfaces.duplicate_report_risk: MODERATE — third-party render errors fire both boundary and window.error
surfaces.disposition: F1.6.2: RouteErrorBoundary catches inside AppShell (sidebar/header preserved); Retry clears boundary state without reload (works when error was transient); fallback shows event_id.

surfaces.current_boundary: NONE — ErrorBoundary in main.tsx sits BELOW the providers (inside QueryClientProvider > SettingsProvider > AuthProvider > BrowserRouter). A provider crash destroys the boundary's ability to render.
surfaces.user_visible_behavior: BLANK SCREEN — React unmounts the entire tree
surfaces.disposition: F1.6.2: RootErrorBoundary wraps providers (full-screen fallback); accepts optional fallback render prop. Cannot preserve navigation when router itself is broken.

surfaces.surface: Error-reporting transport failures (Sentry captureException, future diagnostics endpoint)
surfaces.current_boundary: ErrorBoundary wraps Sentry.captureException in try/catch that silently swallows failures ('Sentry not initialized — ignore')
surfaces.user_visible_behavior: Invisible — user sees 'Something went wrong' fallback regardless of whether the report was delivered
surfaces.diagnostic_behavior: Silent — no fallback log, no event_id surfaced
surfaces.recovery_mechanism: None — user cannot reference a diagnostic ID because none is generated
surfaces.duplicate_report_risk: MODERATE — if both Sentry and the new diagnostics endpoint were active, double delivery would occur
surfaces.disposition: F1.6.1: sendRuntimeErrorReport (contract-backed, may reject) + reportRuntimeError (synchronous, never throws, returns event_id). F1.6.3: Sentry automatic capture DISABLED (defaultIntegrations:false, integrations:[]); backend diagnostics endpoint is the single governed transport.
